before_times: new or returning, and for lashes: a first set, or the date of the last set or fill (it decides a fill or a full set, and the patch test)
which service: a fill, a full set, a lift, brows
for a full set: the look (natural, wispy or full)
for a wedding party: how many people, the date, and where everyone gets ready
after_time: contact lenses (they come out before lash work)
anything the artist should know (a look to keep)
for a visit at home or a venue: the address, parking, and a quiet room with space for a lash bed and a plug
secure_page_only: 18 or older, or a parent or guardian books
an allergy to lash glue, latex or medical tape
eye surgery in the last 3 months, like LASIK
an eye infection, stye or irritation now
a reaction to a lash or brow product before
the lash consent (the glue, the risks, the aftercare), signed
the patch-test check 24 hours after the test
intake_questions.who_may_book: an adult; a parent or guardian for anyone under 18, who signs the consent and stays for the whole visit (and a parent's OK where the state's rules require one for a minor)

stop.words: glue or a chemical in the eye now
stop.say: Rinse the eye with clean running water for 15 minutes. If you can't see or the eye is badly hurt, call 911 now. Otherwise, see an eye doctor or urgent care today.
stop.booking: no booking, and never lashes on a hurt eye

stop.words: a reaction now: eyes or face swelling fast, or trouble breathing
eye pain or a change in sight after lash or brow work
stop.say: Please see a doctor today. Don't pull the lashes off. Your artist is told at once.
stop.booking: the next visit waits until the artist has called

go_on.words: itchy, puffy or red eyelids after a set, with no danger signs
go_on.what: the artist calls within the hour (the owner if the artist is silent 15 minutes) and decides: often a free removal, or a doctor

go_on.words: an eye infection, stye or irritation on the visit day
go_on.what: no lash work on that eye; the visit moves with no fee

safety_and_stop_words.always: the generic screen: danger to life, fire, gas, a medical emergency → call 911, and no booking. Rosie never judges a reaction: the artist or a doctor decides

steps.name: Glue patch test (a few test lashes at each outer corner)
steps.when: 1 to 2 days before a first full set; the same test checks a lift, tint or lamination product added to the booking
steps.who: first-set clients, and anyone whose last test ran out
steps.goodFor: 6 months, or until the studio changes its glue (the example studio's rule)
steps.result: 24 hours after the test, the customer answers on the secure page; anything off: the artist calls and decides (go ahead, a retest with a sensitive glue and a later set with no fee, or no extensions with a full refund); no answer: the artist checks the test lashes before starting

steps.name: Patch test for a tint, lift or lamination
steps.when: at least 1 day before a first tint, lift or lamination
steps.result: the same check and the same outcomes

steps.name: Lash consent on the secure page
steps.when: signed when booking a first set, lift or tint; a parent signs for a teen
steps.result: kept on file; a later booking skips it

steps.name: Bridal lash trial
steps.when: before the wedding day (the owner's setting)
steps.result: the look and the timing for the day are saved for the artist

first_steps_and_forms.prep: for the reminder: come with clean, makeup-free eyes, no mascara, and contact lenses out; plan to lie still with your eyes closed (about 1 hour for a fill, 2½ for a full set); for a visit at home, a quiet room with space for a lash bed and a plug

staff.skills: classic, volume, lifts, tints, lamination, waxing, threading, makeup; only artists with the skill and the license are offered
staff.licenses_or_certificates: each artist's license per state, matched to the services it covers; makeup where the state licenses it
staff.supervision: apprentices and students work only under a licensed artist, where the state's rules allow
staff.who_oks: Sam reads every flagged eye form, OKs any booking after a past reaction, and every wedding party quote over $500
staff.stand_in: a stand-in gets the lash map, the glue used and the patch-test date

children_and_age.who_may_book: an adult; a parent or guardian for anyone under 18, who signs the consent and stays for the whole visit (and a parent's OK where the state's rules require one for a minor)
children_and_age.minors_texts: a teen's booking texts go to the parent or guardian, never to the teen
children_and_age.minors_rules: a parent's written OK for a minor, where the state's rules require it

visit.check_in: at the studio: the check-in code at the desk or the lash bed; at a home or venue: the code from whoever will be there (the bride, or the venue contact when a mobile is given for them)
visit.done: the check-in code, or DONE from the artist; the lash map (curl, lengths, glue) goes in the artist's notes for next time
visit.changes_at_visit: a fill with fewer than half the lashes left is done as a full set only with the customer's yes to the full-set price and a free 2½ hours; extra work (a brow wax, a volume upgrade) is priced and OK'd before it's done
visit.before_work: the artist looks at the patch-test lashes and the eyes, asks if anything changed since the form, and has contact lenses taken out; no lash work on red, swollen or infected eyes

license.note: Optional. Upload anything. Rosie never checks it and never shows it as checked (D96).
license.need: always where the state's rules license lash and brow work: lash extensions, lifts, tints, waxing and lamination fall under cosmetology, esthetics or an eyelash license, as the state form says
license.who: both: the studio holds an establishment license where the state issues one, and each artist holds their own
license.ask: the studio's license number; each artist's number in their invite reply (or the owner sends it)
license.insurance: liability insurance where the state's form or a venue asks for it

never_in_a_text: eye-form answers, allergies, patch-test results and reactions never go in a text or through the AI: only the secure page and the customer's record. Check texts ask nothing personal; the artist asks by phone
